title: Marketplace Europe
desc: A look behind the scenes at one of the world's top toymakers; meaning "play well" in Danish, Lego was founded in Billund in 1932, initially as a producer of wooden bricks for children, but nearly a century later, the company is still growing year-on-year; in 2025, they posted record revenues of over $12bn, with an operating profit of $3.2bn.

title: Marketplace Asia

title: Inside Africa
